changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "log".payment_reminder_log ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, started_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at TIMESTAMP, total_candidates INT, sent_success INT DEFAULT 0, sent_failed INT DEFAULT 0, error_message TEXT ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payment_reminder_log_started_at ON "log".payment_reminder_log (started_at DESC);
